-- Imaoooooooooooooll
local function crazyColorify(frame)
	local runService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local stroke = frame:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")

	runService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		-- Randomize HSV values for "crazy" colors
		local hue = math.random()
		local sat = 0.8 + math.random() * 0.2
		local val = 0.8 + math.random() * 0.2
		local color = Color3.fromHSV(hue, sat, val)

		frame.BackgroundColor3 = color
		if stroke then stroke.Color = color end

		wait(0.05) -- Controls color flickering speed (lower = crazier)
	end)
end

-- GUI Setup
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", game.CoreGui)
gui.Name = "GlassESP_CrazyToggle"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false

local frame = Instance.new("Frame", gui)
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 100)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -110, 0.5, -50)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
frame.Active = true
frame.Draggable = true

local corner = Instance.new("UICorner", frame)
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", frame)
stroke.Thickness = 1.2

crazyColorify(frame)

-- Toggle Button
local toggle = Instance.new("TextButton", frame)
toggle.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 40)
toggle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 30)
toggle.Text = "ESP WRONG GLASS[OFF]"
toggle.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
toggle.TextSize = 14
toggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 230)
toggle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 0, 0)

Instance.new("UICorner", toggle)
Instance.new("UIStroke", toggle).Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)

-- Billboard ESP Function
local function addBillboard(part, tagText, color)
	if not part:FindFirstChild("ESPTag") then
		local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
		billboard.Name = "ESPTag"
		billboard.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 20)
		billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
		billboard.Adornee = part
		billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
		billboard.Parent = part

		local label = Instance.new("TextLabel", billboard)
		label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
		label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		label.Text = tagText
		label.TextColor3 = color
		label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.5
		label.TextScaled = true
	end
end

-- Remove all ESP
local function removeAllESP()
	for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj:FindFirstChild("ESPTag") then
			obj.ESPTag:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

-- Toggle Logic
local espEnabled = false

toggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	espEnabled = not espEnabled

	if espEnabled then
		toggle.Text = "ESP WRONG GLASS [ON]"
		for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
 			if obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj.Name:lower() == "glass" then
				addBillboard(obj, "Glass", Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0))
			end
		end
	else
		toggle.Text = "ESP WRONG GLASS [OFF]"
		removeAllESP()
	end
end)
